description: A qualified index-name — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 108: "Qualification of index-names. Index-names may be qualified in the same manner as data and condition-names, even in cases where uniqueness of reference may already be established." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, ReferenceResolver.ResolveIndexName, once per written reference (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.47 - the 2002 Annex F.2 relaxations of COBOL-85 restrictions (item 108)
